resources.string: Everything in one field, in three rows: REC or the recording time, the camera battery, and the time left on the card. Tap to start; tap to stop (or twice, see Settings).
Shows the camera state. Tap to start or stop recording.
Like the REC field, with the camera battery in large type underneath. For narrow fields. Tap to start or stop recording.
REC and the camera battery side by side, both large. For full-width fields. Tap to start or stop recording.
Battery of the paired camera, and whether its screen is on.
Shows whether the camera is on. Tap twice to switch it off. The camera switches on with its own button.
Recording time left on the card, and the current mode.
Tap to drop a marker in the video being recorded.
